text:
jess_support: Customer (Acme) opened with 401 invalid_api_key across all endpoints. They say the key works from their local laptop curl but their prod service gets 401s since ~07:10 UTC.
ryan_infra: Can you paste a minimal repro request and the header as seen by their service?
bob_acme: here's the curl that works from my laptop:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_ABC123..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
bob_acme: and here's the same request from our prod host (k8s pod) which returns 401. No proxies in front except our nginx ingress.
jess_support: I pulled auth logs for their API key id (key_0a7b). I see ~350 failed auth attempts from that key between 06:58–07:05 UTC, then a system event: `apikey.locked: abuse_protection` at 07:05:12. After that all requests returned 401 with error invalid_api_key.
ryan_infra: Ah — we have an automated temporary lockout for keys that exceed a rapid invalid-attempt threshold. It auto-unlocks after 15m but we can manually unfreeze if needed.
security-bot: audit: key_0a7b: 350 failed auth attempts from 3 distinct IPs; auto-lock triggered.
jess_support: I just unblocked the key via admin tool:
```
keyctl unfreeze --id key_0a7b --reason "support unlock after customer confirmed rotation"
```
ryan_infra: After unfreeze we should see requests succeed. Also noticed some clients retry immediately without backoff causing the spike. Recommend they implement exponential backoff and stop retrying on 401s.
bob_acme: Confirmed — after you unblocked we see 200s from prod. Thanks. Do you suggest we rotate?
jess_support: Yes, rotate the key and update all instances. We left the old key active briefly for their cutover but recommend rotation within 24h. Also advise adding jitter/backoff to reduce lockout risk.
ryan_infra: Follow-ups for us: 1) check if threshold is too low for common improper retry loops, 2) add clearer admin event reason text in the UI, 3) add an explanatory error message when lockout is active (currently same 401).
jess_support: I'll file a ticket and notify account team. Marking resolved for now — customer confirmed success. :white_check_mark:
bob_acme: Thanks everyone :pray:
ryan_infra: cc @sec for policy review later.
